newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks end higher helped by Wall St gains.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks end higher helped by Wall St gains.

text.p: MADRID, Aug 19 (Reuter) 1715 - Madrid stocks closed sharply higher on Tuesday, cheered by a second straight day of gains on Wall Street. *Ibex 35 index up 121.92 or 1.86 percent to 6,674.07 *General index rose 9.96 points, 1.73 percent, to 585.98 *BBV up 75 pesetas to 4,090, Telefonica gains 50 to 4,060

"When Wall Street opens strong, we just follow the rest of Europe," said one Madrid dealer. The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose for a second straight day, calming nervous European markets after an almost three percent drop on Friday.
Banco Santander attracted strong buying interest after its purchase last week of a controlling stake in Brazilian bank Noroeste, rising 4.15 percent, or 175 pesetas, to 4,395.

Dealers said Santander told analysts they bought the bank at favourable ratios and expect a good return on equity. The bank also said it now planned to consolidate its Latin American investments, which was received positively.
Telefonica continued to underperform the market amid an ongoing wrangle involving soccer rights for digital television, which has weighed on sentiment, dealers said.
"It's not good to have independent management with such close ties to the government," said one dealer.
